effect.complicated_bees.careerbees:assas: Hunts down the strongest monster nearby.
effect.complicated_bees.careerbees:busin: Sells items from inventories next to the hive for emeralds.
effect.complicated_bees.careerbees:butch: Culls animals when a herd gets crowded.
effect.complicated_bees.careerbees:creep: Spawns harmless-looking creepers that drop nothing.
effect.complicated_bees.careerbees:crush: Grinds ore on flower pedestals into dust.
effect.complicated_bees.careerbees:curat: Cures zombie villagers, clears bad effects and poisons the undead.
effect.complicated_bees.careerbees:elect: Calls lightning down on mobs nearby.
effect.complicated_bees.careerbees:energ: Feeds power to machines next to the hive.
effect.complicated_bees.careerbees:explo: Sets off small explosions that spare machines.
effect.complicated_bees.careerbees:glazi: Glazes food on flower pedestals. Glazed food gives absorption.
effect.complicated_bees.careerbees:honey: Coats iron ingots on flower pedestals in honeycomb.
effect.complicated_bees.careerbees:junk_: Spends emeralds from inventories next to the hive on worn-out bargains.
effect.complicated_bees.careerbees:mason: Turns rough stone into finished blocks.
effect.complicated_bees.careerbees:minin: Digs ore out of the ground nearby.
effect.complicated_bees.careerbees:picku: Picks up dropped items into the hive.
effect.complicated_bees.careerbees:polic: Arrests monsters nearby and files an incident report with whatever they dropped.
effect.complicated_bees.careerbees:pries: Enchants tools on flower pedestals. Bookshelves near the hive help.
effect.complicated_bees.careerbees:repai: Mends damaged gear on flower pedestals.
effect.complicated_bees.careerbees:retra: Retrains bees on flower pedestals back to their own species' effect.
effect.complicated_bees.careerbees:sharp: Hones weapons on flower pedestals so they hit harder.
effect.complicated_bees.careerbees:taxat: Takes a cut of the loot from mobs passing by.
effect.complicated_bees.careerbees:telep: Swaps blocks around inside the territory.
effect.complicated_bees.careerbees:tempo: Speeds up machines and crops nearby.
gui.careerbees.jei.pedestal.no_inputs: Works on anything a furnace can smelt.
gui.careerbees.mutations.recent_explosio: Something must have blown up close by in the last few seconds
gui.careerbees.settings.ghost: Click with an item to filter for it, or with an empty hand to clear
jei.careerbees.info.bee_gun: Fires a swarm of the loaded bees. The swarm latches onto the first thing its career can work on, waits as long as the bees would in a hive, then does that work once. Drones get used up, but princesses and queens don't. Each shot costs a little honey. Sneak and use to load it, sneak and scroll to pick a chamber.
jei.careerbees.info.pedestal_advanced: Made by using a Vial of Pheromones on a Flower Pedestal. Only bees of the bound species work on its item. Broken, it drops a plain Flower Pedestal.
jei.careerbees.info.pheromones: A Pheromone Frame in a bee housing sometimes leaves a Vial of Pheromones for the queen's species. Use the vial on a Flower Pedestal to bind it to that species, which turns it into an Advanced Flower Pedestal. Only species with a pedestal effect can be bound.
jei.careerbees.info.report: Police bees arrest monsters near the hive. Their drops go to the hive's output along with this report, which lists what was taken, from whom and when.
message.careerbees.bee_gun.no_use: These bees have no use in a gun
message.careerbees.pedestal.no_use: These bees have no use for a pedestal
species.complicated_bees.careerbees:armo: Beats dents out of plate all day long.
species.complicated_bees.careerbees:arti: Paints the hive a new colour every week.
species.complicated_bees.careerbees:bens: Plays a tune for the flowers.
species.complicated_bees.careerbees:butc: Thins the herd when it grows too big.
species.complicated_bees.careerbees:cloc: Winds up every engine in reach.
species.complicated_bees.careerbees:coll: Tidies up whatever folk leave lying about.
species.complicated_bees.careerbees:cook: Glazes anything that sits still long enough.
species.complicated_bees.careerbees:devi: Leaves scorch marks on every flower.
species.complicated_bees.careerbees:engi: Draws up plans for a better hive.
species.complicated_bees.careerbees:fort: Somehow always strikes a rich seam.
species.complicated_bees.careerbees:grad: Four years of study and a hat to show for it.
species.complicated_bees.careerbees:husb: The farm is never short of calves.
species.complicated_bees.careerbees:junk: One bee's rubbish is another bee's treasure.
species.complicated_bees.careerbees:lumb: Fells a tree and keeps the bark.
species.complicated_bees.careerbees:mad_: The lab was there a minute ago.
species.complicated_bees.careerbees:maso: Turns rough stone into neat blocks.
Knows one flower better than anyone alive.
species.complicated_bees.careerbees:plag: Cures the sick and troubles the dead.
species.complicated_bees.careerbees:poli: Takes notes on everyone who passes the hive.
species.complicated_bees.careerbees:repa: Nothing stays broken near this hive.
species.complicated_bees.careerbees:shar: Hones every blade it can find.
species.complicated_bees.careerbees:silk: Lifts stone out whole, without a scratch.
species.complicated_bees.careerbees:smel: Keeps the hive warm and the ore molten.
species.complicated_bees.careerbees:stud: Always late, never without a satchel.
species.complicated_bees.careerbees:tax_: Takes a share of everything that walks by.
species.complicated_bees.careerbees:thie: Your pockets felt lighter. They were.
species.complicated_bees.careerbees:yent: Has a match in mind for every queen.
